Prototype 11 encodes W (100% pure) primarily through EEG (68%), with EOG (29%) and EMG (2%) contribution.
Its EEG signature shows elevated β_h (+16.7 dB, sensitivity=3.7) and elevated β_l (+13.6 dB, sensitivity=3.0).
The β_h activity is present in 100% of each epoch (sustained), with active eye movements (Blink 76% active) and tonic muscle tone.
This is partially coherent with W physiology: confirmed: EMG tonic, EOG active; missing: α elevated+relevant.
